crossRefs.note: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

translations.web: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
translations.bsb: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
translations.kjv: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
translations.asv: I wait for Jehovah, my soul doth wait, And in his word do I hope.
